trajectory.patch:
The compilation errors indicate a problem with the `ZTEST_SUITE` macro definition in `ztest_test.h`.

The error `initializer element is not constant` on the line initializing the `.stats` member, combined with `expected declaration or statement at end of input` on an earlier line of the macro expansion, suggests a syntax error is confusing the compiler's parser.

The `.stats` member is the last element in the `ztest_suite_node` struct initializer within the `ZTEST_SUITE` macro. The line ends with a trailing comma, which, while allowed in C99 and later standards, can cause issues with some compilers or configurations. Other similar macros in the same file, like `Z_TEST`, do not have a trailing comma on their last initializer element.

Removing this trailing comma resolves the syntax ambiguity for the compiler, which in turn fixes the cascading parsing errors.

subsys/testsuite/ztest/include/zephyr/ztest_test.h
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
		.predicate = PREDICATE,                                                            \
		.stats = &UTIL_CAT(z_ztest_suite_node_stats_, SUITE_NAME),             \
	}

		.stats = &UTIL_CAT(z_ztest_suite_node_stats_, SUITE_NAME)              \
	}
